try: Open {url}: map, index and a slim "kanban" tab (it faded at turn 30; nobody touched it after the decisions at turn 22). Type /why map: last touch turn 30, 7 turns since, fades after 8.

Send any message (e.g. "what is left for Monday?"). After the reply the map fades to a tab (untouched for 8 turns) and the controller asks "Remove the kanban pane?": y removes it, n keeps the tab, x removes it for good. Your answer is recorded like any consent.

Click the map tab (or Tab to it and press Enter): it comes back at once. A click, a scroll, Tab into a pane or a c/r on a card count as a touch (metrics.jsonl pane_touch); /why kanban explains the fade and the removal question.
Faded panes stay in {dir}/modules.json ("state": "faded"); no rule ever deletes one. Thresholds: fadeAfterTurns / askRemoveAfterTurns in rules.json.
